cells.normalized_text: Restores 70 HP on activation and grants Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Devour restores 70 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds. Scoring a kill while Devour is active restores 70 HP, grants Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration. Grenade Ability Energy on Kill: Tier 1 Combatant = 7.5% | T2 = 11.6% | T3 = 13.75% | T4 = 20% | Guardians = 20%
Void Buffs applied to the user last longer. Devour: 50% Increased duration. Invisibility: 40% increased duration. Void Overshield: 50% increased duration.

Void Ability Kills grant Devour. Devour becomes Enhanced Devour. Enhanced Devour: Restores 140 HP on activation and grants Enhanced Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Enhanced Devour restores 140 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds. Scoring a kill while Enhanced Devour is active restores 140 HP, grants doubled Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration. Grenade Ability Energy on Kill: Tier 1 Combatant = 15% | T2 = 23.2% | T3 = 27.5% | T4 = 40% | Guardians = 40%
On Orb of Power or Void Breach Pickup: Grants Devour for 5+2.5 seconds.

sources.supports: Unless exempted, percentage ability-energy gains use recipient Chunk Energy Scaling.
Tiers differ from ranks. For Devour, tiers5/6 use the tier4 amount; vehicles are inconsistent.

Feed the Void confirms70/140HP, doubled energy, and timer addition5/8seconds. Persistence and Starvation entries match duration inputs. Full activation producers and all source caps are not implemented.
Patch states200→140 Devour healing and stat-scaled ability returns. It does not explicitly distinguish ordinary70HP; use the updated Compendium/Clarity split instead of applying the reduction twice.
Fixes Secant Filaments shortening Devour with Persistence. Do not adopt older forum bug reports as intended source-duration behavior.

implementation.activation: Validate positive inputs/cap>=duration and actual living recipient. New status uses caller duration; reactivation adds current extension and preserves maximum admitted cap. Each accepted activation heals but does not itself award kill energy.
implementation.healing: 70 DAMAGE through devour_healing strength profile, then mandatory external health_projection. Shared enhancement contributes+1 delta byMAX, yielding140 before projection.
implementation.kills: Require holder==event_actor and historical Devour presence. A bounded per-status death_id set prevents duplicate rewards. Extend, heal, then independently classify the historical victim for grenade energy.
implementation.energy: T1=.075,T2=.116,T3=.1375,T4/T5/T6/Guardian=.2 charge_fraction, doubled through devour_grenade for enhanced Devour; current selected grenade recipient processes BASE gain exactly once via its own scaling and CES.
implementation.unknown_tier: Missing/conflicting classification emits devour_unclassified and skips only energy; no live-corpse fallback.
implementation.lifecycle: Holder death, cleanse and expiry remove status; grantor detach retains it. Existing enhancement modifiers are read on each benefit; current selected grenade determines destination. Pure checkpoints retain deadline, cap and bounded identity sets.
implementation.safety: No arbitrary gameplay cooldown or feedback limit. Known rejected/clipped heal does not block later energy; unknown heal stops after prior local duration/health commits and cannot replay.

remaining: 共享普通/强化收益已实现；Feed the Void 的 Void/Prismatic 自动激活、Starvation 的 Orb/Void Breach 拾取、Secant/Trapper/Unbreakable 等正式生产者尚未接入。本轮增强来源只表达收益翻倍，不代表完整 Aspect。
Persistence 的明确八秒续时已由修饰输入验证，初始duration和cap由调用者给出；完整三类Void Buff时长、职业属性惩罚和正式Fragment装配尚未完成。
原表与Clarity确认初始10/15、Starvation5/7.5及每次延长5/8秒，但本轮未独立确认所有来源上限。cap为必填校准输入，普通10/15和长来源20的测试不能冒充全来源上限实测。重施加保留较高cap/首次来源的政策仍待校准。
手雷表按BASE接入当前选中技能的gain_profile和CES，依据通用Chunk规则及官方属性缩放；原表每个数值的全部测量条件、异常来源/活动/装备叠加、当前属性采样和多杀同帧政策仍需逐条校准。测试.5/.75 CES和2.25增益是显式合成输入。
70/140 HP先经过外部必需health_projection；测试使用1:1身份映射，不是最终D2到Minecraft全局生命缩放。完整Health/Shield基础层恢复曲线、治疗阻断与特殊金装交互仍需原作校准。
击杀要求死亡前已观察到该持有者的Devour；同次击杀新授予状态不能逆向取得旧击杀收益。持续状态/收益按当前持有者，增强修饰按处理时查询，原作换装/赠予/同击顺序仍需实测。
T1–T6和实际玩家按历史回执分类，T5/T6取T4；无法或多重分类只跳过回能并发出诊断，已知治疗/续时仍执行。原版mob不会自动被猜成D2 Tier，车辆及全部D2对象目录仍待装配。
death_ids只有receipt_seconds期间的幂等保证，状态结束清理全部身份；没有人为冷却或连锁上限。未知治疗保留已提交时长/生命但不执行后续回能，真实宿主的故障恢复和跨世界重启仍待完成。
完整生产规则包、子职业/装备装配、HUD/美术及物理世界持久化仍未完成。
